metadata.title: The Unwelcome Crossing
metadata.description: make the desert feel like it is taking the travellers: no path, no water, no way back. the last water is drunk at a cistern at dusk; the caravan walks out and the trail erases behind them; the dunes start to boom and the sand moves without wind; jackals answer from three bearings; by the last section there is no water, no landmark and no route, and the piece simply stops being able to go on
